claim: H4-FIELD-FAMILY: AMAR field profiles differ by dictionary family, not only by gross coverage.

labelVocabulary.label: false-low-risk
labelVocabulary.meaning: Strict SKD headword coverage may undercount prose, citation, or variant-headword evidence.

labelVocabulary.label: high-coverage-check
labelVocabulary.meaning: VCP high AMAR coverage should be checked as exposed, usable headword coverage.

labelVocabulary.label: edition-delta-check
labelVocabulary.meaning: AP/AP90 deltas need edition, parser, and normalization separation.

labelVocabulary.label: scope-baseline-check
labelVocabulary.meaning: Specialized dictionaries should be judged against their own topic scope.

labelVocabulary.label: direction-index-control
labelVocabulary.meaning: Reverse-bilingual and index works are controls for lookup direction and genre.

method: Select SKD missing examples from indigenous-prose low fields for false-low review.
Select VCP covered examples from indigenous-prose high fields for high-coverage review.
Select AP covered examples that AP90 marks missing to isolate edition/parser/normalization deltas.
Round-robin ARMH, FRI, and BHS examples from strong fields plus weak-field controls for specialized baselines.
Round-robin AE, MWE, and index-family non-zero examples as lookup-direction and index controls.
